source_championship.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id"

source_phase.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id"

source_game.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CASE home_field WHEN 'left' THEN 0 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 1 WHEN 'right' THEN 2 ELSE ('invalid home_field: ' || home_field)::integer END AS "home_field", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP) AS "utc", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP))::double precision)::bigint AS "moment", to_char(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "date", (coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '1463 days')::date::varchar AS "cutoff"

source_team_rating.projection: CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", to_char(measure_date::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "measure_date", CAST("offense" AS double precision) AS "offense", CAST("defense" AS double precision) AS "defense"

source_player.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("position" AS VARCHAR) AS "position"

source_player_game.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("game_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "game_id", CAST("player_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "player_id", CAST("side" AS VARCHAR) AS "side", CAST("on_minute" AS INTEGER) AS "on_minute", CAST("off_minute" AS INTEGER) AS "off_minute", CAST("red" AS BOOLEAN) AS "red"

source_goal.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("game_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "game_id", CAST("player_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "player_id", CAST("side" AS VARCHAR) AS "side", CAST("minute" AS INTEGER) AS "minute", CAST("penalty" AS BOOLEAN) AS "penalty", CAST("own_goal" AS BOOLEAN) AS "own_goal"

team_ratings.partitionQuery: SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR) AS __partition,r.* FROM result_team_ratings r

appearances.partitionQuery: SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR) AS __partition,r.* FROM result_appearances r

source_championship.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id" FROM "championship"

source_phase.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id" FROM "phase"

source_game.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CASE home_field WHEN 'left' THEN 0 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 1 WHEN 'right' THEN 2 ELSE error('home_field ' || home_field) END AS "home_field", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", strftime(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS "utc", epoch(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP))::BIGINT AS "moment", strftime(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS "date", (coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 1463 DAY)::DATE::VARCHAR AS "cutoff" FROM "game"

source_team.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id" FROM "team"

source_team_rating.query: SELECT CAST("team_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "team_id", strftime(measure_date::DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "measure_date", CAST("offense" AS DOUBLE) AS "offense", CAST("defense" AS DOUBLE) AS "defense" FROM "team_rating"

source_player.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("position" AS VARCHAR) AS "position" FROM "player"

source_player_game.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("game_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "game_id", CAST("player_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "player_id", CAST("side" AS VARCHAR) AS "side", CAST("on_minute" AS INTEGER) AS "on_minute", CAST("off_minute" AS INTEGER) AS "off_minute", CAST("red" AS BOOLEAN) AS "red" FROM "player_game"

source_goal.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("game_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "game_id", CAST("player_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "player_id", CAST("side" AS VARCHAR) AS "side", CAST("minute" AS INTEGER) AS "minute", CAST("penalty" AS BOOLEAN) AS "penalty", CAST("own_goal" AS BOOLEAN) AS "own_goal" FROM "goal"
